result.summary: Found 1 major issue: the promotional banner text has insufficient contrast and is difficult to read.

issues.description: The promotional banner uses white text on a very pale mint-green background. The heading '3 free deliveries for you' is low contrast and the subtext 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' is barely legible.
issues.suggestion: Use dark green or black text on the light banner, or darken/saturate the banner background, ensuring at least WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1 for the subtext and 3:1 for the large heading).
